title: Chinese 2 Day VIP Tour: Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon, Hoover Dam
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience the breathtaking beauty of Lower Antelope Canyon on a private tour from Las Vegas. This exclusive adventure offers a personalized journey through one of the most stunning natural wonders in the American Southwest.

Your day begins with a private pick-up from your Las Vegas hotel. Groups of 1-5 will travel in a luxury SUV, while groups of 6-14 will enjoy the comfort of a high-roof, extended-length touring van. Relax and enjoy the scenic drive through the desert landscapes as you head toward the iconic sights.

Upon arrival, explore the narrow, winding passageways of Lower Antelope Canyon with a knowledgeable guide. Marvel at the vibrant colors and intricate rock formations that make this canyon a photographer's dream. The tour also includes stops at the iconic Horseshoe Bend, where you’ll take in panoramic views of the Colorado River, and a scenic overlook of Lake Powell. This private tour is perfect for those seeking a unique and intimate experience away from the crowds.
